items:
📊 **Base-Year Master Matrix (Deliberate Examiner Traps):**
• **CPI Inflation:** New series with base **2024 = 100** (Released 12 Feb 2026).
• **GDP Series:** New series with base **2022-23 = 100** (Released 27 Feb 2026).
• **IIP Series:** New series with base **2022-23 = 100** (Effective 28 May 2026).
• **WPI Inflation:** Base year **unchanged at 2011-12 = 100** (Deliberate trap against CPI's new 2024 base!).

📈 **Quarterly Growth & Inflation Trajectory (Jan ➔ Feb ➔ Mar):**
• **GDP Growth (NSO 1st Advance Estimates):** Pegs real GDP growth at **7.4%** for FY26 (vs 6.5% FY25); India officially became the world’s **4th-largest economy (~$4.18 Trillion)**, overtaking Japan and on track to surpass Germany by 2030.
• **CPI Inflation (2024 Base):** Jan 2026 at **2.75%** ➔ Feb 2026 rose to **3.21%** (Rural: 3.37%, Urban: 3.02%, Food Inflation: 3.47%).
• **IIP Output:** Dec 2025 touched a 26-month high of **7.8%** ➔ Jan 2026 slowed down to **4.8% YoY** (sharp trend reversal).
• **Eight Core Industries (ICI):** Jan 2026 grew **+4.0%** ➔ Feb 2026 eased to **+2.3%** (Core industries constitute **40.27%** of total IIP weight).
• **WPI Inflation (2011-12 Base):** Jan 2026 at **1.81%** ➔ Feb 2026 at **2.13%**.

⚖️ **Fiscal Deficit Revisions (Impact of New 2022-23 GDP Base):**
• **FY25 Fiscal Deficit:** Revised from 4.80% ➔ **4.90%** of GDP (Nominal GDP = ₹318.07 Lakh Cr).
• **FY24 Fiscal Deficit:** Revised from 5.63% ➔ **5.70%** of GDP (Nominal GDP = ₹289.84 Lakh Cr).
• **FY23 Fiscal Deficit:** Revised from 6.40% ➔ **6.70%** of GDP.

blocks.content: 🎯 Exam Angle → 🔥 HIGH — 1) Three distinct base years (CPI=2024, WPI=2011-12, GDP/IIP=2022-23); 2) IIP trend reversal (7.8% ➔ 4.8%); 3) CPI direction (2.75% ➔ 3.21% is an upward move); 4) Upward revised fiscal deficit trio (4.8➔4.9 / 5.63➔5.7 / 6.4➔6.7).
